g.text: atglance - server health at a glance
atglance status [--all] [-o table|json] running and failed services
atglance service <name> [-o table|json] one service, with 24 h log summary
atglance export [--logs] JSON for every loaded service
atglance watch [--interval 5s] [--all] live view, Ctrl+C to stop
atglance login [--server URL] connect to an AtGlance console
atglance logout forget the API token
atglance whoami show the console user
atglance check [--scheduled] check the console connection and key expiry (alias: doctor)
atglance system register|status register this host, show its console state
atglance system deregister|reactivate change its state (--force: admin login)
atglance system rotate-key replace the system key (API v1)
atglance config backup <svc>|--all upload unit files (queued when offline)
atglance config list|pull|diff|restore versions in the console
atglance sync [--scheduled] upload the queue and changed unit files
atglance schedule enable|disable|status daily check and sync from cron
